hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/\b(cat|less|more|head|tail|type)\b[^\n&|;]{0,40}\.env(\.[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)?\b/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: refusing to print .env contents to the transcript. ADMIN_PASSWORD and DATABASE_URL live there \u2014 read individual values with grep for a specific key instead.');process.exit(2)}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Block Bash commands that would dump .env contents (ADMIN_PASSWORD, DATABASE_URL) into the transcript
Stamp a marker so the PostToolUse Bash hook formats only files this command wrote

PostToolUse.description: Run Prettier on each edited TS/JS file, so pnpm lint never fails on formatting
Run Prettier on TS/JS files a Bash command wrote (sed -i, python heredocs), which the Edit|Write hook misses
